stages.message: You're almost a VIP brigade member with maximum protection and speed! Go to the bot to purchase the VIP brigade — everything is quick and without unnecessary steps.
You already have an active VIP brigade.
Answer the question: do you have an existing brigade?

You have an active brigade - you're awesome! But to transfer all your keys and settings to the new VIP brigade, we need a way to identify your current brigade.
You have two options:
Please type the brigadier name. That is, an adjective and a laureate's surname, for example "Веселый Эйнштейн" or "Потрясающая Кюри".
That doesn't look like a name, please try again. Be careful — you need to enter an adjective and a laureate's surname, for example "Веселый Эйнштейн" or "Потрясающая Кюри"
Great, now please tell us your 6 magic words.

Open sesame didn't work — something's wrong with the name or the words. Be careful — the name consists of an adjective and a laureate's surname, for example "Веселый Эйнштейн" or "Потрясающая Кюри". And the six words must be in exactly the same order we gave them to you!

If you don't remember the name and/or magic words - maybe it's time to start fresh.
Sorry, you already failed entering the name and 6 words before, so you'll need to wait %d hour(s) before trying again.
Okay, you have access to the key manager; all you need to do is log in (https://vpn.works/) and click the "VIP-Squad" button in the top right corner.
